reviews.text: The service was great, The tech was very patient and he front desk. Service is awesome.. My Puppy Was not nervous at all.
Dr. HARINGTON GREAT ANIMAL DOCTOR. Everytime I take our pets in always the most cost effective treatment and outcome wonderful. If pet is beyond help or way to expensive he'll let you know.

Dr. Osterheld performed surgery on my Chihuahua/Pug mix. He was able to remove my dog's tumor, located above the head. As a gift, they provided a Free Dental Cleaning for my fur baby (Mama's) while she was under anesthesia. Great service overall! Definitely recommend!! 👍
Amazing people hands down love them recommend great pricing great people

We have been taking our dog here since he was a little baby and we absolutely love this place! The receptionist at the front desk remembers us and greets our dog with his name which shows they care. The vet techs and the Dr are also very reassuring and thorough with their work. They also have very good prices compared to other places I’ve been to in the past. Highly recommend!
Alex dr farrington and Brianna were a great help today with our pup highly them

I took my dog white boy in there today and he had an issue that he has had before so I asked him could they give me the medication that he has gotten before to make him feel better and heal the doctor filled it just this one time which I'm very grateful because I cannot afford the office visit so he gave me antibiotics and pain medication. I really think if it wasn't for the front receptionist she put in a good word for me and it helped me out a lot to get this medication otherwise the infection would have got really bad and he would have got really sick and more likely died on me which I cannot do death of my fur baby he is my world. So I recommend this veterinary office for anyone that has a checkup, sick animal, all vaccines for their fur babies.
Thank you for your time giving your feedback to us. We really appreciate your time.
Always kind and compassionate
Best service you can ask for!
Service is stupendous! BriAnna is exceptionally wonderful at the desk!

We have been bringing multiple pets here for years and would not take them anywhere else. Dr. Farrington is a wonderful veterinarian and the staff is always helpful, courteous and friendly. You will not find a better Vet in the area
Zuleik, thank you for the 5 stars and the recommendation - it means the world to us!

I absolutely love Catalina Animal Hospital💜 I’ve been coming here for over 15 years. I've taken all three of my animals to Catalina this year. I've seen many people come and go, but I was so happy that Brianna is still there. She has provided exceptional customer service from the beginning. I appreciate her kindness, empathy, and compassion for animals. Brianna is the first person you see when you arrive at Catalina, so her always greeting with a smile and kindness sets a positive tone for the visit. I saw Dr. Farrington, who is my absolute favorite, but I also love his wife, Maria. I took my dog for dental work, and the technicians did a good job. Overall, Catalina Animal Hospital is my favorite! I highly recommend Catalina Animal Hospital.

Love this place!  We have been going here for years even though it's farther away than where we live.  Dr Farrington is excellent and are go to vet! Brianna who is there to greet us is wonderful, caring and compassionate along with the rest of the staff!  Thank you for being there!

We took Chewie to Catalina Animal Hospital for his well check and vaccines. We pointed out a few masses that had formed on Chewie. The vet recommended to have them removed and to have a teeth cleaning. We took Chewie in for his surgery for the mass removal and teeth cleaning on July 13, 2026. They gave him absolutely wonderful care. They called us to let us know how Chewie was doing. They also perform holistic healing exercises like Reiki and gave him holistic essential flowers. Since Chewie has come home post surgery he has be relaxed and happy. He's eating and drinking like normal. There was no stress or anxiety. Which is amazing since Chewie is a dog who has high anxiety. They called the next day to check on Chewie. They take the time to check on their patients. That's a veterinarian office that truly cares.

We have been going to Dr. Farrington for several years. He has treated 9 of our dogs over that time. We appreciate the level of care and consideration the entire team at Catalina Animal Hospital gives and has given to all of our dogs past and present. Thank you Catalina Animal Hospital! 💞
People are always friendly!

Our cat is a grouchy old man and he always is difficult with your staff. All of you have ALWAYS been  more than patient with him. You have also been kind to me and have answered all of my many questions.   Thank you,  Liz & Smokey Blue
They put up with my very mean cat for many times

The whole experience for my Prada (cat) was fantastic. We recently just moved here from NM and need a new vet. Found Catalina which is just a few minutes from where we live. So from reception to exam, Alex our tech and Dr Wildflower were amazing! Thank you, we’ll certainly be coming back!

I've been going  to Catalina for almost 7 years now and I have to say they are very good at taking care of pets. The entire staff is very professional but personable at the same time. Prices are very reasonable as well compared to other vets. I highly recommend them.

10/10 service, this is the second time they help my fur baby! They’re so friendly and took care of her while she stayed all day with them for an exam. I’m sure if she could speak she would say they were great too! Alex was an amazing help and would recommend this place to everyone! They even opened on the day before July 4th, which not many places do nowadays!

I recently brought my cat in. They charged me  over twelve hundred dollars and they couldn’t even offer to treat her for a full day with fluids. I had to take her home and watch her suffer and pass away within 24 hrs. Please be weary of these veterinarian who act like they give “helpful” options when it’s reality it’s just money they want. They do not offer any advice over the phone either. I will never come back here.

Feel disappointed. This place has become one of the corporate vets. Stacking all they can. No military discount. They have offered this previously. Lab prices have gone way up. I feel they used to care more for the pets. Now it feels the pet needs everything vs a stair-step approach to care.
We had to take our dog to be euthanized. Staff were incredibly compassionate and understanding. This has been my sixth dog and this was by far the best end of life experience we've had for a pet.
DO NOT TAKE YOUR CAT HERE!! i would give 0 if i could
This place is ALWAYS slammed. BUT they have fair prices and are a small practice. They treat you and your pet like family. Worth the wait every time.
Aurelius, Thank you for your time giving your feedback to us. We really appreciate your time

Great doctor!!! Prices are lower than other places .
They have helped my cat  a few times .
Excellent Care for our pups for years!

Only one doc in today, got here at 8:20am and still waiting. Just need vaccination and nail trim-was informed mandatory well exam since it's been over 1 years since the last. (She said they just started this a few months the ago) is this the norm?
They are great here. Love the walk in feature!

I was skeptical about coming here maybe for how small it seemed which was wrong on my part but I decided to come here for my puppy’s first check up. I loved the staff, their attentiveness and care for your pets as well as the time they actually take in making sure your pet leaves with the proper treatment plan. I’ve gone to different places whenever Catalina is closed but it is always my first choice. Everyone is welcoming and after 5 years, I still take my pet here for anything he may need.

Thank you for your service and for your dedication, it is truly appreciated. <3
Thank you for your time giving your feedback to us. We really appreciate your time.
Iliana, thank you for the 5 stars and the recommendation - it means the world to us!

The staff here is amazing! Very kind and attentive. I can tell they love their job and are here to take care of all of the animals needs. I’ve been coming here for over 17 years. I’m now living in Mesa and it’s still worth the drive for me.

I've driven by this place for years and never brought any of my pets here. Today was our first visit and I can't say enough good things about this vet office. Every single staff member I encountered was just top notch.

Every person was so sweet to my dog and you could tell she was very comfortable and happy to be there and be handled by the staff. The office is clean, comfortable, and a lot bigger than it looks from the street.

Weeks before my visit I called to get a quote for what I needed. The receptionist was so kind and patient and gave me all of the info I needed. The pricing ended up being better than quoted. The cost of an exam, nail trim, and allergy shot for a 70lb dog was very reasonable. Like, shockingly reasonable.

No prices were gouged, they have a crew of really solid humans working there, and my dog says the place in its entirety passes the vibe check...and for that they will continue to get my business.

My only regret is I wish we would've come sooner.
I take all 3 of my dogs here. I love Brianna at the front desk. She has such a beautiful soul, she is warm and welcoming when you go in. She just sets the tone for the rest of your visit ❤️
Great vet for my dog
Great vet. They are fair and seem to genuinely care about animals.
Very nice vet and offers wholistic care.  Prices are reasonable and caring staff.
Caring staff, more reasonable rates and options.
They gave fast service and compassion.
Very nice and friendly staff quick with looking at our Athena. Recommended lots of options and provided great service to us all.
So nice and caring to my pets

Every time I'm come in here , everyone is extremely kinda, thoughtful and helpful.  My dog Rico is 10 months old and he ate a dog toy which got stuck in his intestines. Catalina saved him. I will always come back here!
Dr. F. saved my dog.  He had a surgery gone bad at another place and he fixed him.  So much gratitude.

If I could give this vet a higher # of star I would , staff and Dr are awesome caring and conscious of cost they offer options and work with what you can do at the time of visit with out the guilt but with love and concern 😟 for the pet My Doggie is in good hands and I have a pice of mind ❤️
Amazing staff
Mandi, thank you for the 5 stars and the recommendation - it means the world to us!

Might be good with cats and small dogs, but not my German Shepherd.  Dr Avi was great with him, but all new staff 4 years later.
My dog was scared... Avi took control...was on the floor sharing treats... No one there will do that now.  Huxton reacted to their fear!!! We got nowhere for the second time here.  Need to find someplace that has a good vet!
Lisette, thank you for the 5 stars and the recommendation - it means the world to us!
They were great to my dog Coconut.
Very friendly and helpful for my dog, and they really worked with me regarding the price, Thank You Dr.
Veerna, thank you for the 5 stars and the recommendation - it means the world to us!
Julie, thank you for the 5 stars and the recommendation - it means the world to us!
Always treats my animals very well

Very professional Very kind staff.A homeless man came in today and asked for some water.The lady at the desk gave him two bottles and wished him a wonderful day.I am very impressed to see such kindness .

Love the walk-in feature. Allows you to go there exactly when you & your pet are ready to be there. They were quick to see us. Originally quoted me almost 3k to do a mass removal surgery on my elderly Chihuahua. Called me back a few days later & advised me if I did the surgery in the next 3 days they could do it for 1k. I advised them that I needed to check my funds & would get back to them. Called back & set up a surgery appt for 2 days later. When I took her in they tried to say it was going to be $1800. I said no I was quoted 1k minus the $75 that I paid for them to set the  appt. So they agree that $925 was the remaining balance. I leave her & then they call me & tell me that half has to be paid up front so I go back up there & give them another $425 so they can do the surgery & then when I picked her up I paid the remaining $500. Was advised to return in 14 days to have sutures removed.

My Cat Doodlebug was vomiting blood tinged, used their walk in service..I was greeted warmly. Dr Farrington was awesome, explained everything. I was impressed and will be returning with my other fur babies.

I love this hospital for my senior chi, he does very well in the company of the staff and I have had no problems with his care. We have been here many times over the last few years after moving close by and they are always helpful, timely, and well priced. I appreciate the staff and the care they provide for our pets, thank you!
Carrie, Thank you for your time giving your feedback to us. We really appreciate your time.
First time pet owner, this vet made everything easy for me. Also ended up paying alot less then I expected.
Melva, Thank you for your time giving your feedback to us. We really appreciate your time.
I have been taking my dogs here for years. They are very affordable, honest and caring ! I would highly recommend to anyone.

Been coming to this place about five years now with Vivi and brought a new client in named Bagheera. The staff loved on Bagheera as he is a 9 week old kitten and gave me the best advice for making sure he didn’t have any worms. They’ve always treated both my cats respectfully and have answered many of my questions since I’m attending vet assistant schooling as well. Love this place as it is a very convenient 5 minute walk away from my place of residence.

Love this place! Everyone takes great care of our pets (kids)
Been coming here for over 10 years.
I have been bringing my animals here for 15 years. The care and compassion shown by the doctors and staff is incredible. They give a breakdown of the costs and ways to keep care budget friendly.
Our pets have been with Catalina since 2003, the staff are very caring, supportive, and the prices are very reasonable.
My dogs were having separate issues, vet was quick to handle and take care of my babies

This is a local neighborhood pet hospital. Their staff are friendly. They offer a variety of services. Best of all they have walk-in hours, which come in handy when you can't schedule same day appointments. Reasonable rates. I highly recommend.
Great first time experience. Walked in and was seen promptly!
Love the fact that I'm able to walk in first thing in the morning and be seen so quickly.
Been using Catalina for years. Good service at a fair price! Recommend!
This is the only place I will bring all my dogs to. Very thoughtful and caring

I have been bringing my animals to Catalina veterinary hospital for over 30 years  they are very professional ,knowledgeable ,friendly , and helpful . I have recommended them to my family and friends since I first started seeing them .
Dr. Farrington and his team are one of kind! They’re office is clean, the staff is friendly and the prices are reasonable

Been bringing my elderly cat Telly and my rescue dog Pooki for about two years and have no plans on changing their vet anytime soon. The team is super easy to contact via email for refills and the front desk staff are great at giving speedy responses and knowing their clients. I feel bad that I don’t know their names, given that they know all my pets and why I’m visiting most of the time before I even check in. Pictured: Telly calmly waiting at the vet, and Pooki at her birthday party the day after her vet visit
